_readme: Hand-entered from published annual/interim reports. This is not scraped —
TradingView's scanner doesn't expose revenue/PAT/book-value detail at the
columns verified in src/lib/tradingview.ts, only EPS/PE at the latest-price
level, which already lands in daily_prices. Nothing here is inferred.
reportUrl is required, not optional-in-practice: an unsourced fundamentals
row is a claim with no way to check it later. If you don't have the URL
yet, leave the row out rather than guess or leave it null.
periodEnd: the reporting period's end date, not the announcement date.
This is a TEMPLATE. SCOM's row below is real, verified data from the
FY2026 annual report. EQTY and KCB are still structurally-shaped
placeholders with null figures — replace with actual figures from each
company's investor-relations page before seeding those two.

extra.note_no_dividend_data: This document (H1 2026 press release) contains NO per-share dividend information — no declaration, no amount, no ex-date, no payment date. It is a financial performance report, not a dividend announcement. This Fundamental row does NOT resolve derivedYieldCurrencyUnverified for BKG: whether TradingView's 7.27% derived yield (2026-09-09 capture) reflects the same reportingCurrency/exchangeCurrency conflation confirmed for UMME remains genuinely unknown. The only dividend-adjacent figure here is a balance-sheet accrual, not a per-share fact: 'Dividends payable' stood at RWF 24.2bn at 30 June 2026, down from RWF 50.2bn at 30 June 2025 (restated) — suggestive that a real dividend obligation exists, but not usable to derive a per-share amount without knowing the exact share count and period each balance relates to.
extra.revenueBasis: 'revenue' above is Total Operating Income (net interest income + net non-interest income) — the standard top-line figure for a bank, not comparable in construction to a non-financial company's revenue line (e.g. SCOM's).
extra.assuranceLevel: REVIEWED, not fully audited — the document's own words: 'Reviewed consolidated financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026', prepared 'in accordance with Law No. 07/2008 relating to organization of Banking, and requirements of regulation No. 03/2016 of 24/06/2016 on Publication by banks of Financial Statements and other disclosures, and Law No. 52/2008 of 10/09/2008 governing Insurance Companies.' isAudited=false reflects this distinction deliberately, not a missing-data gap.
extra.h12025ComparativeRestated: The H1 2025 comparative figures in this release are explicitly marked '(Restated)' in both the P&L and balance-sheet tables — worth knowing before comparing against any earlier-vintage H1 2025 figures sourced elsewhere.

fundamentals._status: PARTIAL — H1 2026 revenue/PAT/EPS/book value are REAL and sourced from BK Group's own reviewed (not fully audited) H1 2026 press release. dpsDeclared is null: no per-share dividend figure exists anywhere in this document. This record does not confirm or rule out whether BKG's TradingView-derived yield suffers the UMME-class currency-conflation bug — that requires an actual dividend declaration document, not a performance report.

extra.sourcing_tier: MIXED — epsBasic and bookValuePerShare are PRIMARY SOURCE (BK Group's own H1 2026 press release, comparative '2025' column, independently cross-confirmed against that same document's explicit YE2025 ROAA/ROAE — see BKG's H1 2026 Fundamental row for the full document). dpsDeclared=53.04 and this row's existence at all come from a Google AI Overview citing secondary aggregators (simplywall.st, stockanalysis.com, tradingview.com's own dividends page, africanfinancials.com), NOT a primary company or NSE/RSE filing directly reviewed in this session. This is a meaningfully different evidence tier from every other entry in this fixture.
extra.corroboration_check_passed: 45% payout ratio x 117.8 EPS = 53.01, matching the claimed 53.04 DPS to within 0.03 — an independent arithmetic cross-check against BK Group's own primary-source EPS, not just trusting the claim as-is.
extra.corroboration_check_2_passed: TradingView's own already-captured derived yield for BKG (dpsDerivedKes=4.5822, dpsConfidence=low, captured 2026-09-09) sits within 1.9% of 53.04 RWF converted at BK Group's own stated 2026-06-30 FRW/KES rate (11.36) -> 4.669 KES. This is the actual resolution to the derivedYieldCurrencyUnverified question raised for BKG: unlike UMME (off by a ~27-28x factor, a raw currency-unit conflation), BKG's derived figure looks like a genuine, roughly-correct RWF->KES conversion. Not proof of zero error, but structurally a different and much less severe situation than UMME's.
extra.discrepancy_found_lowers_trust_in_the_AI: The AI Overview's own claimed KES conversion ('approx. Ksh 3.71-3.96') does NOT match 53.04 RWF at BK Group's own stated rate (4.669 KES) - a real, material discrepancy. This doesn't necessarily invalidate the underlying 53.04 RWF figure (which independently corroborates via the payout-ratio check above), but it does mean the Overview's own derived arithmetic is not fully reliable, and its other uncorroborated claims (e.g. FY2025 Net Income of RWF 110.1bn, which was NOT independently cross-checked here) should be treated with the same caution.
extra.netIncomeFY2025Rwf_UNVERIFIED: AI Overview claims RWF 110.1bn (+20.9% y-o-y) for FY2025 net income. NOT independently cross-checked in this session and NOT populated into the 'pat' field above for that reason - left null rather than trusted on an uncorroborated claim.
extra.recommendedNextStep: Fetch the africanfinancials.com document directly (used as reportUrl above) or an equivalent NSE/RSE announcement to upgrade this from 'internally consistent' to 'primary-source confirmed', matching the standard every other fixture entry in this file was held to.

fundamentals._status: UNVERIFIED-BUT-CONSISTENT — dpsDeclared sourced from a Google AI Overview (secondary aggregators), not a primary document. Passes two independent arithmetic cross-checks against BK Group's own primary-source H1 2026 figures. This is the evidence that resolves (with meaningful but not absolute confidence) the derivedYieldCurrencyUnverified question raised for BKG two messages ago: structurally does NOT look like UMME's currency-conflation bug. Do not treat dpsDeclared here as equivalent in confidence to SCOM's or UMME's PDF-sourced figures until a primary document is checked.

extra.note_currency_mismatch: dpsDeclared=222.0 is REAL and denominated in Ugandan Shillings (Ushs), not KES — that's now honest to say, because this column stopped being named revenueKes/dpsDeclaredKes/etc. and just holds a number in whatever security_master.reportingCurrency says (UGX for this ticker). Before that rename, this field had to stay null: writing 222.0 into a column literally named *Kes would have repeated, inside this seed data, the exact currency-conflation bug this record exists to document — TradingView's dividends_yield_current showed 393.65% on 2026-09-09, traced directly to dividing a Ushs-denominated dividend by the KES close with no FX conversion (see YIELD_IMPLAUSIBLE in quality_log and tradingview.ts's assertRows). revenue/pat/epsBasic/bookValuePerShare are still null — not a currency problem anymore, a genuine extraction-precision one (see basicDilutedEpsUshs_note below). No KES conversion is attempted anywhere in this record; reportingCurrency is what tells a reader how to interpret 222.0.

rawUgxFiguresFromFY2025FinancialStatemen.basicDilutedEpsUshs_note: Reported as a LOSS (negative, shown in parentheses in the source statement) — two figures appear side by side in the table, (137.7) and (314.4); which column is Company vs Group, or FY2025 vs FY2024, was not confidently resolved from the extracted text alone and is not asserted here as a single number.

extra.noFinalDividendTwoConsecutiveYears: Confirmed independently from two sources: the FY2026 AGM Notice ('the Board of Directors decision not to declare a final dividend for the year ended 31st December 2025') and the same document's embedded prior-year AGM notice for FY2024 ('...not to declare a final dividend for the year ended 31 December, 2024'). The FY2025 Financial Statement's own dividend-proposed note independently corroborates this for FY2025 (both interim and final rows show '-' as of the FY2025 balance-sheet date).
